e2e_c1_dense_coloc.measurement_families: Decode-graph steps (pure decode batches, padded to the next capture size) read the KERNEL_ONLY tables attention_kernel_only.csv, linear_op_kernel_only.csv; prefill and mixed steps read the CUDA_EVENT tables. e2e_c6_moe_coloc_ep4_tp2_dp2_pp2.measurement_families: Every step runs eager. With forward_launch in the eager CPU-overhead CSV, Frontier prices each forward in two streams (ticket 33): the device stream from the KERNEL_ONLY tables attention_kernel_only.csv, linear_op_kernel_only.csv, moe_kernel_only.csv plus the eager kernel gap, the host stream from forward_launch. At PP2 this needs the per-stage forward_launch of ticket 38 (T33-G15); without forward_launch, eager steps read the CUDA_EVENT tables. The runner names every path, so the checked-in default tables never load.
